title: Iceland From Above
prompt: A 60-second aerial nature spectacle over Iceland — black sand beaches, cliffside waterfalls, steaming volcanic fissures, glacier tongues — no characters, no plot, the camera itself is the protagonist. Realistic cinematic aerial look, no dialogue and no subtitles by design; engine-free natural ambience only.
